name: zdeclient_qsand_copy_event_template_defaults
description: zDEClient::CopyQSandEventTemplateDefaults copies the current global quicksand event-template defaults into the caller-provided template.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient quicksand source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x455ed0 validates ECX as the destination pointer and copies eleven DWORDs, the full 0x2c-byte zDEClient_QSandEventTemplate, from g_zDEClient_QuickSandEventTemplateDefaults into that destination.
The native smoke verifies every field in the copied quicksand event template, including flags, point count, material pointers, slope/depth/radius, center vector, and damage-owner pointer.
